summary: IperionX Limited, an ASX- and Nasdaq-listed titanium/rare-earths developer, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC attaching a Notice of Annual General Meeting, the foreign-private-issuer equivalent of a US proxy statement/AGM notice. The AGM will be held November 25, 2026 in Sydney, with a record date of November 23, 2026; all resolutions will be decided by poll. Agenda items are routine: consideration of the FY2026 annual report, adoption of the Remuneration Report (Resolution 1), and re-election of directors Todd Hannigan (Resolution 2) and Beverly Wyse (Resolution 3). No special-situation transaction, price, stake, or advisor is disclosed; no deal terms are stated.
